findings.description: Both `_latekey-new.mjs` and `_latekey-old.mjs` import the server, JPEG fixtures, and layout module using paths copied from `tests/two-browser.mjs`, but those paths do not resolve from `evidence/flake-92`. Running either committed scratch script stops at module loading, so the presence-delay experiment cannot be rerun from these files.
findings.title: Evidence scripts fail before opening a browser

evidence.explanation: The newly added scripts both use `./serve.mjs`, `./jpeg-fixtures.mjs`, and `../web/layout.js`; the working browser test imports those modules from `tests/`, and none of the referenced files exists at the paths relative to `evidence/flake-92`.
